listen_address.description: IP address the daemon listens on. Use `0.0.0.0` for all interfaces.

listen_port.description: Port for incoming BitTorrent peer connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum total number of peer connections.

max_active_torrents.description: Maximum number of torrents that can be active (downloading or seeding) simultaneously.

max_uploads_per_torrent.description: Maximum number of upload slots per active torrent.

max_downloads.description: Maximum number of torrents allowed to download simultaneously (hard cap).

upload_rate_limit.description: Global upload rate limit in KB/s. `0` means unlimited.

download_rate_limit.description: Global download rate limit in KB/s. `0` means unlimited.

data_dir.description: Directory to store torrent data files.

watch_dir.description: Directory to watch for new .torrent files (auto-add enabled).

completed_dir.description: Directory to move completed downloads to (leave empty to disable auto-move).

bandwidth_schedule_enabled.description: Enable scheduled bandwidth throttling (e.g., off-peak limits).

bandwidth_schedule_start.description: Start time of scheduled period (24-hour format, e.g., `22:00`).

bandwidth_schedule_end.description: End time of scheduled period (24-hour format).

bandwidth_schedule_upload_limit.description: Upload rate limit during scheduled period (KB/s).

bandwidth_schedule_download_limit.description: Download rate limit during scheduled period (KB/s).

enabled.description: Whether to use this tracker for new torrents.

default_trackers.description: List of default trackers to add to newly added torrents.

dht_enabled.description: Enable DHT (Distributed Hash Table) for peer discovery without trackers.

pex_enabled.description: Enable Peer Exchange (PEX) to discover additional peers from connected peers.

lpd_enabled.description: Enable Local Peer Discovery (LPD) for local network peer detection.

peer_encryption.description: Encryption policy for peer connections: 'required', 'preferred', or 'disabled'.

api_enabled.description: Enable the JSON-RPC API (for web UI and automation).

api_host.description: Host binding for the API (e.g., `127.0.0.1` for localhost only, `0.0.0.0` for all).

api_password_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the API password (for security; never store plaintext).
